verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כֶּ֧רֶם הָיָ֛ה לְנָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּיִזְרְעֶ֑אל אֵ֚צֶל הֵיכַ֣ל אַחְאָ֔ב מֶ֖לֶךְ שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥar had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh ke·rem hā·yāh lə·nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî ’ă·šer bə·yiz·rə·‘el ’ê·ṣel hê·ḵal ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: Some time after these events Naboth the Jezreelite owned a vineyard in Jezreel next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU depois destas coisas que, Nabote, o jizreelita, tinha uma vinha em Jizreel junto ao palácio de Acabe, rei de Samaria.

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אַחְאָ֣ב אֶל־ נָב֣וֹת׀ לֵאמֹר֩׀ תְּנָה־ לִּ֨י אֶֽת־ כַּרְמְךָ֜ וִֽיהִי־ לִ֣י לְגַן־ יָרָ֗ק כִּ֣י ה֤וּא קָרוֹב֙ אֵ֣צֶל בֵּיתִ֔י וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לְךָ֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יו כֶּ֖רֶם ט֣וֹב מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אִ֚ם ט֣וֹב בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ אֶתְּנָה־ לְךָ֥ כֶ֖סֶף מְחִ֥יר זֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’aḥ·’āḇ ’el- nā·ḇō·wṯ lê·mōr tə·nāh- lî ’eṯ- kar·mə·ḵā wî·hî- lî lə·ḡan- yā·rāq kî hū qā·rō·wḇ ’ê·ṣel bê·ṯî wə·’et·tə·nāh lə·ḵā taḥ·tāw ke·rem ṭō·wḇ mim·men·nū ’im ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ’et·tə·nāh- lə·ḵā ḵe·sep̄ mə·ḥîr zeh
verses.literal: So Ahab said to Naboth Give me your vineyard to use as a vegetable garden since it is next to . . . my palace I will give you a better . . . vineyard in its place or if you prefer . . . I will give you its value in silver
verses.literalPt: Então Acabe falou a Nabote, dizendo: Dá-me a tua vinha, para que me sirva de horta, pois está vizinha ao lado da minha casa; e te darei por ela outra vinha melhor: ou, se for do teu agrado, dar-te-ei o seu valor em dinheiro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר נָב֖וֹת אֶל־ אַחְאָ֑ב חָלִ֤ילָה לִּי֙ מֵֽיהוָ֔ה מִתִּתִּ֛י אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֥ת אֲבֹתַ֖י לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer nā·ḇō·wṯ ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ ḥā·lî·lāh lî Yah·weh mit·tit·tî ’eṯ- na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḇō·ṯay lāḵ
verses.literal: But Naboth replied - The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers
verses.literalPt: Porém Nabote disse a Acabe: Guarde-me o SENHOR de que eu te dê a herança de meus pais.

verses.original: וַיָּבֹא֩ אַחְאָ֨ב אֶל־ בֵּית֜וֹ סַ֣ר וְזָעֵ֗ף עַל־ הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו נָבוֹת֙ הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֔י וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ נַחֲלַ֣ת אֲבוֹתָ֑י וַיִּשְׁכַּב֙ עַל־ מִטָּת֔וֹ וַיַּסֵּ֥ב אֶת־ פָּנָ֖יו וְלֹֽא־ אָ֥כַל לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō ’aḥ·’āḇ ’el- bê·ṯōw sar wə·zā·‘êp̄ ‘al- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- dib·ber ’ê·lāw nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî way·yō·mer lō- ’et·tên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- na·ḥă·laṯ ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯāy way·yiš·kaḇ ‘al- miṭ·ṭā·ṯōw way·yas·sêḇ ’eṯ- pā·nāw wə·lō- ’ā·ḵal lā·ḥem
verses.literal: So Ahab went to his palace sullen and angry because . . . Naboth the Jezreelite had told him . . . I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers He lay down on his bed turned his face away and refused to eat . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Acabe veio desgostoso e indignado à sua casa, por causa da palavra que Nabote, o jizreelita, lhe falara, quando disse: Não te darei a herança de meus pais. E deitou-se na sua cama, e voltou o rosto, e não comeu pão.

verses.original: וַתָּבֹ֥א אֵלָ֖יו אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ וַתְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֗יו מַה־ זֶּה֙ רוּחֲךָ֣ סָרָ֔ה וְאֵינְךָ֖ אֹכֵ֥ל לָֽחֶם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō ’ê·lāw ’î·ze·ḇel ’iš·tōw wat·tə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·lāw mah- zeh rū·ḥă·ḵā sā·rāh wə·’ê·nə·ḵā ’ō·ḵêl lā·ḥem
verses.literal: Soon his wife Jezebel came in and asked Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém, vindo a ele Jezabel, sua mulher, lhe disse: Que há, que está tão desgostoso o teu espírito, e não comes pão?

verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלֶ֗יהָ כִּֽי־ אֲ֠דַבֵּר אֶל־ נָב֨וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֜י וָאֹ֣מַר ל֗וֹ תְּנָה־ לִּ֤י אֶֽת־ כַּרְמְךָ֙ בְּכֶ֔סֶף א֚וֹ אִם־ חָפֵ֣ץ אַתָּ֔ה אֶתְּנָה־ לְךָ֥ כֶ֖רֶם תַּחְתָּ֑יו וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לֹֽא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן לְךָ֖ אֶת־ כַּרְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·hā kî- ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’el- nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî wā·’ō·mar lōw tə·nāh- lî ’eṯ- kar·mə·ḵā bə·ḵe·sep̄ ’ōw ’im- ḥā·p̄êṣ ’at·tāh ’et·tə·nāh- lə·ḵā ḵe·rem taḥ·tāw way·yō·mer lō- ’et·tên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- kar·mî
verses.literal: Ahab answered . . . Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite and told him Give me your vineyard for silver or if you wish I will give you another vineyard in its place And he replied I will not give you my vineyard
verses.literalPt: E ele lhe disse: Porque falei a Nabote, o jizreelita, e lhe disse: Dá-me a tua vinha por dinheiro; ou, se te apraz, te darei outra vinha em seu lugar. Porém ele disse: Não te darei a minha vinha.

verses.original: וַתֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אִיזֶ֣בֶל אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ אַתָּ֕ה עַתָּ֛ה תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה מְלוּכָ֖ה עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל ק֤וּם אֱכָל־ לֶ֙חֶם֙ וְיִטַ֣ב לִבֶּ֔ךָ אֲנִי֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לְךָ֔ אֶת־ כֶּ֖רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer ’ê·lāw ’î·ze·ḇel ’iš·tōw ’at·tāh ‘at·tāh ta·‘ă·śeh mə·lū·ḵāh ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl qūm ’ĕ·ḵāl- le·ḥem wə·yi·ṭaḇ lib·be·ḵā ’ă·nî ’et·tên lə·ḵā ’eṯ- ke·rem nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî
verses.literal: But his wife . . . Jezebel said to him Do you not reign over Israel Get up eat some food and be cheerful . . . for I will get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite
verses.literalPt: Então Jezabel, sua mulher lhe disse: Governas tu agora no reino de Israel? Levanta-te, come pão, e alegre-se o teu coração; eu te darei a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita.

verses.original: וַתִּכְתֹּ֤ב סְפָרִים֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם אַחְאָ֔ב וַתַּחְתֹּ֖ם בְּחֹתָמ֑וֹ וַתִּשְׁלַ֣ח הַסְפָרִים אֶל־ הַזְקֵנִ֤ים וְאֶל־ הַֽחֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּעִיר֔וֹ הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים אֶת־ נָבֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḵ·tōḇ sə·p̄ā·rîm bə·šêm ’aḥ·’āḇ wat·taḥ·tōm bə·ḥō·ṯā·mōw wat·tiš·laḥ has·p̄å̄·rīm ’el- haz·qē·nīm wə·’el- ha·ḥō·rîm ’ă·šer bə·‘î·rōw hay·yō·šə·ḇîm ’eṯ- nā·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name sealed them with his seal and sent them to the elders . . . and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city
verses.literalPt: Então escreveu cartas em nome de Acabe, e as selou com o seu sinete; e mandou as cartas aos anciãos e aos nobres que havia na sua cidade e habitavam com Nabote.

verses.original: וַתִּכְתֹּ֥ב בַּסְּפָרִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר קִֽרְאוּ־ צ֔וֹם וְהוֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ נָב֖וֹת בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḵ·tōḇ bas·sə·p̄ā·rîm lê·mōr qir·’ū- ṣō·wm wə·hō·wō·šî·ḇū ’eṯ- nā·ḇō·wṯ bə·rōš hā·‘ām
verses.literal: In the letters . . . she wrote Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people
verses.literalPt: E escreveu nas cartas, dizendo: Apregoai um jejum, e ponde Nabote diante do povo.

verses.original: וְ֠הוֹשִׁיבוּ שְׁנַ֨יִם אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּעַל֮ נֶגְדּוֹ֒ וִיעִדֻ֣הוּ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥כְתָּ אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֶ֑לֶךְ וְהוֹצִיאֻ֥הוּ וְסִקְלֻ֖הוּ וְיָמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·wō·šî·ḇū šə·na·yim ’ă·nā·šîm bə·nê- ḇə·lî·ya·‘al neḡ·dōw wî·‘i·ḏu·hū lê·mōr bê·raḵ·tā ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·me·leḵ wə·hō·w·ṣî·’u·hū wə·siq·lu·hū wə·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: But seat two . . . . . . scoundrels opposite him and have them testify . . . You have cursed both God and the king Then take him out and stone him to death
verses.literalPt: E ponde defronte dele dois filhos de Belial, que testemunhem contra ele, dizendo: Blasfemaste contra Deus e contra o rei; e trazei-o fora, e apedrejai-o para que morra.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲשׂוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֜וֹ הַזְּקֵנִ֣ים וְהַחֹרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר הַיֹּֽשְׁבִים֙ בְּעִיר֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר שָׁלְחָ֥ה אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אִיזָ֑בֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּתוּב֙ בַּסְּפָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר שָׁלְחָ֖ה אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·śū ’an·šê ‘î·rōw haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ha·ḥō·rîm ’ă·šer hay·yō·šə·ḇîm bə·‘î·rōw ka·’ă·šer šā·lə·ḥāh ’ă·lê·hem ’î·zā·ḇel ka·’ă·šer kā·ṯūḇ bas·sə·p̄ā·rîm ’ă·šer šā·lə·ḥāh ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: So the elders and nobles who lived in Naboth’s city did as Jezebel had instructed - in the letters she had written to them
verses.literalPt: E os homens da sua cidade, os anciãos e os nobres que habitavam na sua cidade, fizeram como Jezabel lhes ordenara, conforme estava escrito nas cartas que lhes mandara.

verses.original: קָרְא֖וּ צ֑וֹם וְהֹשִׁ֥יבוּ אֶת־ נָב֖וֹת בְּרֹ֥אשׁ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: qā·rə·’ū ṣō·wm wə·hō·šî·ḇū ’eṯ- nā·ḇō·wṯ bə·rōš hā·‘ām
verses.literal: They proclaimed a fast and gave Naboth a seat of honor among the people
verses.literalPt: Apregoaram um jejum, e puseram a Nabote diante do povo.

verses.original: וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ שְׁנֵ֨י הָאֲנָשִׁ֥ים בְּנֵֽי־ בְלִיַּעַל֮ וַיֵּשְׁב֣וּ נֶגְדּוֹ֒ וַיְעִדֻהוּ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַבְּלִיַּ֜עַל אֶת־ נָב֗וֹת נֶ֤גֶד הָעָם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ נָב֛וֹת אֱלֹהִ֖ים וָמֶ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּצִאֻ֙הוּ֙ מִח֣וּץ לָעִ֔יר וַיִּסְקְלֻ֥הוּ בָאֲבָנִ֖ים וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·’ū šə·nê hā·’ă·nā·šîm bə·nê- ḇə·lî·ya·‘al way·yê·šə·ḇū neḡ·dōw way·‘i·ḏu·hū ’an·šê hab·bə·lî·ya·‘al ’eṯ- nā·ḇō·wṯ ne·ḡeḏ hā·‘ām lê·mōr bê·raḵ nā·ḇō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·me·leḵ way·yō·ṣi·’u·hū mi·ḥūṣ lā·‘îr way·yis·qə·lu·hū ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: And the two scoundrels . . . . . . came in and sat opposite Naboth and these men - testified against him before the people saying Naboth has cursed both God and the king So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death
verses.literalPt: Então vieram dois homens, filhos de Belial, e puseram-se defronte dele; e os homens, filhos de Belial, testemunharam contra ele, contra Nabote, perante o povo, dizendo: Nabote blasfemou contra Deus e contra o rei. E o levaram para fora da cidade, e o apedrejaram, e morreu.

verses.original: וַֽיִּשְׁלְח֖וּ אֶל־ אִיזֶ֣בֶל לֵאמֹ֑ר סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַיָּמֹֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·lə·ḥū ’el- ’î·ze·ḇel lê·mōr suq·qal nā·ḇō·wṯ way·yā·mōṯ
verses.literal: Then they sent word to Jezebel . . . Naboth has been stoned to death
verses.literalPt: Então mandaram dizer a Jezabel: Nabote foi apedrejado, e morreu.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ אִיזֶ֔בֶל כִּֽי־ סֻקַּ֥ל נָב֖וֹת וַיָּמֹ֑ת וַתֹּ֨אמֶר אִיזֶ֜בֶל אֶל־ אַחְאָ֗ב ק֣וּם רֵ֞שׁ אֶת־ כֶּ֣רֶם׀ נָב֣וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֗י אֲשֶׁ֤ר מֵאֵן֙ לָתֶת־ לְךָ֣ בְכֶ֔סֶף כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין נָב֛וֹת חַ֖י כִּי־ מֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ’î·ze·ḇel kî- suq·qal nā·ḇō·wṯ way·yā·mōṯ wat·tō·mer ’î·ze·ḇel ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ qūm rêš ’eṯ- ke·rem nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî ’ă·šer mê·’ên lā·ṯeṯ- lə·ḵā ḇə·ḵe·sep̄ kî ’ên nā·ḇō·wṯ ḥay kî- mêṯ
verses.literal: When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned to death she said to Ahab Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite who refused to give it to you for silver For Naboth is no longer alive but dead
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Jezabel que já fora apedrejado Nabote, e morrera, disse a Acabe: Levanta-te, e possui a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita, a qual te recusou dar por dinheiro; porque Nabote não vive, mas é morto.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כִּשְׁמֹ֥עַ אַחְאָ֖ב כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת נָב֑וֹת וַיָּ֣קָם אַחְאָ֗ב לָרֶ֛דֶת אֶל־ כֶּ֛רֶם נָב֥וֹת הַיִּזְרְעֵאלִ֖י לְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ’aḥ·’āḇ kî mêṯ nā·ḇō·wṯ way·yā·qām ’aḥ·’āḇ lā·re·ḏeṯ ’el- ke·rem nā·ḇō·wṯ hay·yiz·rə·‘ê·lî lə·riš·tōw
verses.literal: And when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead he got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Acabe, que Nabote já era morto, levantou-se para descer para a vinha de Nabote, o jizreelita, para tomar posse dela.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū hat·tiš·bî lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Elias, o tisbita, dizendo:

verses.original: ק֣וּם רֵ֗ד לִקְרַ֛את אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּשֹׁמְר֑וֹן הִנֵּה֙ בְּכֶ֣רֶם נָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ יָ֥רַד שָׁ֖ם לְרִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: qūm rêḏ liq·raṯ ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer bə·šō·mə·rō·wn hin·nêh bə·ḵe·rem nā·ḇō·wṯ ’ă·šer- yā·raḏ šām lə·riš·tōw
verses.literal: Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel who is in Samaria See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth where he has gone . . . to take possession of it
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, desce para encontrar-te com Acabe, rei de Israel, que está em Samaria; eis que está na vinha de Nabote, aonde tem descido para possuí-la.

verses.original: וְדִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הֲרָצַ֖חְתָּ וְגַם־ יָרָ֑שְׁתָּ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה בִּמְק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לָקְק֤וּ הַכְּלָבִים֙ אֶת־ דַּ֣ם נָב֔וֹת יָלֹ֧קּוּ הַכְּלָבִ֛ים אֶת־ דָּמְךָ֖ גַּם־ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ê·lāw lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh hă·rā·ṣaḥ·tā wə·ḡam- yā·rā·šə·tā wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ê·lāw lê·mōr kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer lā·qə·qū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm ’eṯ- dam nā·ḇō·wṯ yā·lōq·qū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm ’eṯ- dā·mə·ḵā gam- ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: Tell him that this is what the LORD says Have you not murdered a man and seized his land Then tell him . . . . . . that this is also what the LORD says In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth there also the dogs will lick up your blood yes yours
verses.literalPt: E falar-lhe-ás, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: Porventura não mataste e tomaste a herança? Falar-lhe-ás mais, dizendo: Assim diz o SENHOR: No lugar em que os cães lamberam o sangue de Nabote lamberão também o teu próprio sangue.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אַחְאָב֙ אֶל־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ הַֽמְצָאתַ֖נִי אֹיְבִ֑י וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מָצָ֔אתִי יַ֚עַן הִתְמַכֶּרְךָ֔ לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’aḥ·’āḇ ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū ham·ṣā·ṯa·nî ’ō·yə·ḇî way·yō·mer mā·ṣā·ṯî ya·‘an hiṯ·mak·ker·ḵā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: When Elijah arrived Ahab said to him So you have found me out my enemy He replied I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD
verses.literalPt: E disse Acabe a Elias: Já me achaste, inimigo meu? E ele disse: Achei-te; porquanto já te vendeste para fazeres o que é mau aos olhos do SENHOR.

verses.original: הִנְנִ֨י מֵבִי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ רָעָ֔ה וּבִעַרְתִּ֖י אַחֲרֶ֑יךָ וְהִכְרַתִּ֤י לְאַחְאָב֙ מַשְׁתִּ֣ין בְּקִ֔יר וְעָצ֥וּר וְעָז֖וּב בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mē·ḇī ’ê·le·ḵā rā·‘āh ū·ḇi·‘ar·tî ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā wə·hiḵ·rat·tî lə·’aḥ·’āḇ maš·tîn bə·qîr wə·‘ā·ṣūr wə·‘ā·zūḇ bə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants I will cut off from Ahab every male in Israel both slave and free
verses.literalPt: Eis que trarei mal sobre ti, e arrancarei a tua posteridade, e arrancarei de Acabe a todo o homem, tanto o escravo como o livre em Israel;

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אֶת־ בֵּיתְךָ֗ כְּבֵית֙ יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־ נְבָ֔ט וּכְבֵ֖ית בַּעְשָׁ֣א בֶן־ אֲחִיָּ֑ה אֶל־ הַכַּ֙עַס֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִכְעַ֔סְתָּ וַֽתַּחֲטִ֖א אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- bê·ṯə·ḵā kə·ḇêṯ yā·rā·ḇə·‘ām ben- nə·ḇāṭ ū·ḵə·ḇêṯ ba‘·šā ḇen- ’ă·ḥî·yāh ’el- hak·ka·‘as ’ă·šer hiḵ·‘as·tā wat·ta·ḥă·ṭi ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: I will make your house like that of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like that of Baasha son of Ahijah because you have provoked My anger and caused Israel to sin
verses.literalPt: E farei a tua casa como a casa de Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, e como a casa de Baasa, filho de Aías; por causa da provocação, com que me provocaste e fizeste pecar a Israel.

verses.original: וְגַ֨ם־ לְאִיזֶ֔בֶל דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הַכְּלָבִ֛ים יֹאכְל֥וּ אֶת־ אִיזֶ֖בֶל בְּחֵ֥ל יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam- lə·’î·ze·ḇel dib·ber Yah·weh lê·mōr hak·kə·lā·ḇîm yō·ḵə·lū ’eṯ- ’î·ze·ḇel bə·ḥêl yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: And the LORD . . . also speaks concerning Jezebel The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel
verses.literalPt: E também acerca de Jezabel falou o SENHOR, dizendo: Os cães comerão a Jezabel junto ao antemuro de Jizreel.

verses.original: הַמֵּ֤ת לְאַחְאָב֙ בָּעִ֔יר יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכְּלָבִ֑ים וְהַמֵּת֙ בַּשָּׂדֶ֔ה יֹאכְל֖וּ ע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ham·mêṯ lə·’aḥ·’āḇ bā·‘îr yō·ḵə·lū hak·kə·lā·ḇîm wə·ham·mêṯ baś·śā·ḏeh yō·ḵə·lū ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Anyone belonging to Ahab who dies in the city will be eaten by dogs and anyone who dies in the field will be eaten by the birds of the air
verses.literalPt: Aquele que morrer dos de Acabe, na cidade, os cães o comerão; e o que morrer no campo as aves do céu o comerão.

verses.original: רַ֚ק לֹֽא־ הָיָ֣ה כְאַחְאָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִתְמַכֵּ֔ר לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁר־ הֵסַ֥תָּה אֹת֖וֹ אִיזֶ֥בֶל אִשְׁתּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: raq lō- hā·yāh ḵə·’aḥ·’āḇ ’ă·šer hiṯ·mak·kêr la·‘ă·śō·wṯ hā·ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer- hê·sat·tāh ’ō·ṯōw ’î·ze·ḇel ’iš·tōw
verses.literal: Surely there was never one like Ahab who sold himself to do evil in the sight of the LORD incited by his wife Jezebel
verses.literalPt: Porém ninguém fora como Acabe, que se vendera para fazer o que era mau aos olhos do SENHOR; porque Jezabel, sua mulher, o incitava.

verses.original: וַיַּתְעֵ֣ב מְאֹ֔ד לָלֶ֖כֶת אַחֲרֵ֣י הַגִּלֻּלִ֑ים כְּכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשׂ֣וּ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹרִ֣ישׁ יְהוָ֔ה מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaṯ·‘êḇ mə·’ōḏ lā·le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê hag·gil·lu·lîm kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer hō·w·rîš Yah·weh mip·pə·nê bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: He committed the most detestable acts by going after idols just like the Amorites whom the LORD had driven out before the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: E fez grandes abominações, seguindo os ídolos, conforme a tudo o que fizeram os amorreus, os quais o SENHOR lançou fora da sua possessão, de diante dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֩ כִשְׁמֹ֨עַ אַחְאָ֜ב אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ וַיִּקְרַ֣ע בְּגָדָ֔יו וַיָּֽשֶׂם־ שַׂ֥ק עַל־ בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וַיָּצ֑וֹם וַיִּשְׁכַּ֣ב בַּשָּׂ֔ק וַיְהַלֵּ֖ךְ אַֽט׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ ’aḥ·’āḇ ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yiq·ra‘ bə·ḡā·ḏāw way·yā·śem- śaq ‘al- bə·śā·rōw way·yā·ṣō·wm way·yiš·kaḇ baś·śāq way·hal·lêḵ ’aṭ
verses.literal: When Ahab heard these words he tore his clothes put on sackcloth - and fasted He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que Acabe, ouvindo estas palavras, rasgou as suas vestes, e cobriu a sua carne de saco, e jejuou; e jazia em saco, e andava mansamente.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אֵלִיָּ֥הוּ הַתִּשְׁבִּ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- ’ê·lî·yā·hū hat·tiš·bî lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite saying
verses.literalPt: Então veio a palavra do SENHOR a Elias tisbita, dizendo:

verses.original: הֲ‍ֽרָאִ֔יתָ כִּֽי־ נִכְנַ֥ע אַחְאָ֖ב מִלְּפָנָ֑י יַ֜עַן כִּֽי־ נִכְנַ֣ע מִפָּנַ֗י לֹֽא־ אָבִי הָֽרָעָה֙ בְּיָמָ֔יו בִּימֵ֣י בְנ֔וֹ אָבִ֥יא הָרָעָ֖ה עַל־ בֵּיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hărā·’î·ṯā kî- niḵ·na‘ ’aḥ·’āḇ mil·lə·p̄ā·nāy ya·‘an kî- niḵ·na‘ mip·pā·nay lō- ʾå̄·ḇī hā·rā·‘āh bə·yā·māw bî·mê ḇə·nōw ’ā·ḇî hā·rā·‘āh ‘al- bê·ṯōw
verses.literal: Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me Because . . . he has humbled himself before Me I will not bring the calamity during his days but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son
verses.literalPt: Não viste que Acabe se humilha perante mim? Por isso, porquanto se humilha perante mim, não trarei este mal nos seus dias, mas nos dias de seu filho o trarei sobre a sua casa.
